class Dataset(Series[] series, Request[] requests, Settings settings)

Dataset read()
    Series[] series := []
    lines := read_lines("input/series.csv")
    for line := lines[1:][]
        row := line.split(",")
        selected := -1
        for: index < int(#series)
            if series[index].name == row[0]
                selected = index
        if selected < 0
            selected = int(#series)
            series = series.append(Series(row[0]))
        series[selected].points = series[selected].points.append(Point(hundredths(row[1]), hundredths(row[2])))
    for: index < int(#series)
        Point[] ordered := []
        for point := series[index].points[]
            position := int(#ordered)
            ordered = ordered.append(point)
            while position > 0 and point.position < ordered[position - 1].position
                ordered[position] = ordered[position - 1]
                position -= 1
            ordered[position] = point
        series[index].points = ordered
    Request[] requests := []
    lines = read_lines("input/test_points.csv")
    for line := lines[1:][]
        row := line.split(",")
        requests = requests.append(Request(row[0], hundredths(row[1])))
    string[][] rows := []
    for line := read_lines("input/params.txt")[]
        rows = rows.append(line.split(" ")[1:])
    return Dataset(series, requests, Settings(rows))

class Estimate(bool defined, real64 value, real64[] weights)

class Fit(int[] positions, real64[] values, int bandwidth, string kernel, bool local_linear, bool diagnostics)
    real64[] fitted := []
    real64[] leverage := []
    real64 edf := 0.0
    defined := true
    if diagnostics
        for: index < int(#positions)
            local result := evaluate(positions[index])
            fitted = fitted.append(result.value)
            if result.defined
                leverage = leverage.append(result.weights[index])
            else
                defined = false
        if defined
            edf = selection.total(leverage)

    Estimate evaluate(int position)
        int[] used := []
        real64[] weights := array(#positions, fill = 0.0)
        real64[] kernel_values := []
        real64[] differences := []
        x0 := selection.as_real(position) / 100.0
        h := selection.as_real(bandwidth) / 100.0
        real64 kappa := if kernel == "epanechnikov" then 0.75 elif kernel == "biweight" then 0.9375 else 1.09375
        for: index < int(#positions)
            if absolute(positions[index] - position) < bandwidth
                used = used.append(index)
                delta := selection.as_real(positions[index]) / 100.0 - x0
                u := delta / h
                t := 1.0 - u * u
                weight := kappa * t
                if kernel != "epanechnikov"
                    weight *= t
                if kernel == "triweight"
                    weight *= t
                kernel_values = kernel_values.append(weight)
                differences = differences.append(delta)
        minimum := if local_linear then 2 else 1
        if int(#used) < minimum
            return Estimate(false, 0.0, weights)
        real64 s0 := 0.0
        real64 t0 := 0.0
        real64 s1 := 0.0
        real64 s2 := 0.0
        real64 t1 := 0.0
        for: index < int(#used)
            k := kernel_values[index]
            d := differences[index]
            s0 += k
            t0 += k * values[used[index]]
            s1 += k * d
            s2 += k * d * d
            t1 += k * d * values[used[index]]
        if local_linear
            determinant := s0 * s2 - s1 * s1
            for: index < int(#used)
                weights[used[index]] = kernel_values[index] * (s2 - s1 * differences[index]) / determinant
            return Estimate(true, (s2 * t0 - s1 * t1) / determinant, weights)
        for: index < int(#used)
            weights[used[index]] = kernel_values[index] / s0
        return Estimate(true, t0 / s0, weights)

import selection = "./selection.qui"
import math

real64 square_root(real64 value)
    result := math.sqrt(value)
    return result

real64 absolute_real(real64 value)
    return if value < 0.0 then -value else value

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

real64 median(real64[] values)
    ordered := values.sorted()
    middle := int(#ordered) / 2
    return if #ordered % 2 == 1 then ordered[middle] else (ordered[middle - 1] + ordered[middle]) / 2.0

real64[][] cholesky(real64[][] matrix)
    size := int(#matrix)
    real64[][] lower := array(nat(size), fill = array(nat(size), fill = 0.0))
    for: row < size
        for: column <= row
            sigma := matrix[row][column]
            for: k < column
                sigma -= lower[row][k] * lower[column][k]
            lower[row][column] = if row == column then square_root(sigma) else sigma / lower[column][column]
    return lower

real64[] solve(real64[][] lower, real64[] right)
    size := int(#right)
    real64[] intermediate := array(nat(size), fill = 0.0)
    real64[] solution := array(nat(size), fill = 0.0)
    for: row < size
        value := right[row]
        for: k < row
            value -= lower[row][k] * intermediate[k]
        intermediate[row] = value / lower[row][row]
    for: offset < size
        row := size - 1 - offset
        value := intermediate[row]
        for: row + 1 <= k < size
            value -= lower[k][row] * solution[k]
        solution[row] = value / lower[row][row]
    return solution

class LocalFit(real64 value, real64 zeta, real64[] weights)
class Robust(int iteration, real64 scale, int zeros, real64 change)

class Fit(int[] positions, real64[] values, int span, int degree, int iterations, bool diagnostics)
    real64[] rho := array(#positions, fill = 1.0)
    real64[] fitted := []
    real64[] leverage := []
    real64 edf := 0.0
    Robust[] records := []
    if diagnostics
        local fits := [for position := positions[] then local_fit(position)]
        for: 1 <= iteration <= iterations
            local real64[] residuals := []
            for: index < int(#values)
                residuals = residuals.append(values[index] - fits[index].value)
            local scale := median([for value := residuals[] then absolute_real(value)])
            local zeros := 0
            for: index < int(#values)
                u := residuals[index] / (6.0 * scale)
                v := 1.0 - u * u
                rho[index] = if absolute_real(u) < 1.0 then v * v else 0.0
                if rho[index] == 0.0
                    zeros += 1
            local updated := [for position := positions[] then local_fit(position)]
            local real64 change := 0.0
            for: index < int(#values)
                difference := absolute_real(updated[index].value - fits[index].value)
                if difference > change
                    change = difference
            records = records.append(Robust(iteration, scale, zeros, change))
            fits = updated
        for: index < int(#values)
            fitted = fitted.append(fits[index].value)
            leverage = leverage.append(rho[index] * fits[index].zeta)
        edf = selection.total(leverage)

    LocalFit local_fit(int position)
        count := int(#positions)
        q := span * count / 100
        int[] order := []
        for: index < count
            place := int(#order)
            order = order.append(index)
            while place > 0 and absolute(positions[index] - position) < absolute(positions[order[place - 1]] - position)
                order[place] = order[place - 1]
                place -= 1
            order[place] = index
        distance := absolute(positions[order[q - 1]] - position)
        selected := order[0:<q].sorted()
        size := degree + 1
        real64[][] matrix := array(nat(size), fill = array(nat(size), fill = 0.0))
        real64[] right := array(nat(size), fill = 0.0)
        real64[][] basis_rows := []
        real64[] local_weights := []
        for index := selected[]
            a := selection.as_real(absolute(positions[index] - position)) / selection.as_real(distance)
            s := 1.0 - a * a * a
            weight := s * s * s * rho[index]
            delta := selection.as_real(positions[index]) / 100.0 - selection.as_real(position) / 100.0
            basis := [1.0, delta]
            if degree == 2
                basis = basis.append(delta * delta)
            basis_rows = basis_rows.append(basis)
            local_weights = local_weights.append(weight)
            for: row < size
                right[row] += weight * basis[row] * values[index]
                for: column < size
                    matrix[row][column] += weight * basis[row] * basis[column]
        lower := cholesky(matrix)
        beta := solve(lower, right)
        real64[] unit := array(nat(size), fill = 0.0)
        unit[0] = 1.0
        zeta := solve(lower, unit)
        real64[] weights := array(nat(count), fill = 0.0)
        for: offset < q
            real64 sum := 0.0
            for: k < size
                sum += zeta[k] * basis_rows[offset][k]
            weights[selected[offset]] = local_weights[offset] * sum
        return LocalFit(beta[0], zeta[0], weights)

real64 absolute_real(real64 value)
    return if value < 0.0 then -value else value

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

real64 squared_sum(real64[] values)
    real64 result := 0.0
    for value := values[]
        result += value * value
    return result

int first_max(real64[] values)
    best := 0
    for: 1 <= index < int(#values)
        if values[index] > values[best]
            best = index
    return best

real64 residual_square(real64[] observed, real64[] fitted)
    real64 sum := 0.0
    for: index < int(#observed)
        residual := observed[index] - fitted[index]
        sum += residual * residual
    return sum

class Block(int first, int last, int sum, int count)
class Pava(real64[] fitted, Block[] blocks)

Pava pava(int[] numbers, string direction)
    Block[] blocks := []
    for: index < int(#numbers)
        blocks = blocks.append(Block(index, index, numbers[index], 1))
        while #blocks >= 2
            left := blocks[-2]
            right := blocks[-1]
            a := left.sum * right.count
            b := right.sum * left.count
            violates := if direction == "increasing" then a > b else a < b
            if not violates
                break
            blocks = blocks[0:<int(#blocks) - 2].append(Block(left.first, right.last, left.sum + right.sum, left.count + right.count))
    real64[] fitted := array(#numbers, fill = 0.0)
    for block := blocks[]
        value := as_real(block.sum) / as_real(100 * block.count)
        for: block.first <= index <= block.last
            fitted[index] = value
    return Pava(fitted, blocks)

class Estimate(bool defined, real64 value := 0.0, real64[] weights := [])

class Model(string method, int[] positions, int[] numbers)
    values := [for number := numbers[] then as_real(number) / 100.0]
    real64[] fitted := []
    real64[] leverage := []
    has_edf := true
    has_leverage := true
    real64 edf := 0.0
    mode := ""
    direction := ""
    Block[] blocks := []
    real64 rss_increasing := 0.0
    real64 rss_decreasing := 0.0
    int[][] windows := []
    real64 xbar := 0.0
    real64 sxx := 0.0
    real64 slope := 0.0
    real64 intercept := 0.0
    kernels.Fit[] kernel_models := []
    loess.Fit[] loess_models := []
    spline.Fit[] spline_models := []

    void .initialize(string parameter, dataset.Settings settings, string isotonic_mode, bool robust, bool diagnostics)
        count := int(#positions)
        if method == "linear"
            x := [for position := positions[] then as_real(position) / 100.0]
            xbar = total(x) / as_real(count)
            ybar := total(values) / as_real(count)
            real64 sxy := 0.0
            for: index < count
                sxx += (x[index] - xbar) * (x[index] - xbar)
                sxy += (x[index] - xbar) * (values[index] - ybar)
            slope = sxy / sxx
            intercept = ybar - slope * xbar
            for: index < count
                fitted = fitted.append(intercept + slope * x[index])
                leverage = leverage.append(1.0 / as_real(count) + (x[index] - xbar) * (x[index] - xbar) / sxx)
            edf = 2.0
        elif method == "running_mean" or method == "running_median"
            width := int(parameter)
            half := (width - 1) / 2
            for: index < count
                radius := half
                if index < radius
                    radius = index
                if count - 1 - index < radius
                    radius = count - 1 - index
                selected := numbers[index - radius:<index + radius + 1]
                windows = windows.append([index - radius, index + radius])
                sum := 0
                for number := selected[]
                    sum += number
                value := as_real(sum) / as_real(100 * int(#selected))
                if method == "running_median"
                    ordered := selected.sorted()
                    value = as_real(ordered[radius]) / 100.0
                fitted = fitted.append(value)
                leverage = leverage.append(1.0 / as_real(int(#selected)))
            has_edf = method == "running_mean"
            has_leverage = has_edf
            edf = total(leverage)
        elif method == "isotonic"
            mode = isotonic_mode
            direction = mode
            fit := pava(numbers, if mode == "auto" then "increasing" else mode)
            if mode == "auto"
                decreasing := pava(numbers, "decreasing")
                rss_increasing = residual_square(values, fit.fitted)
                rss_decreasing = residual_square(values, decreasing.fitted)
                direction = "increasing"
                if rss_decreasing < rss_increasing
                    direction = "decreasing"
                    fit = decreasing
            fitted = fit.fitted
            blocks = fit.blocks
            has_leverage = false
            edf = as_real(int(#blocks))
        elif method.starts_with("nw_") or method.starts_with("ll_")
            fit := kernels.Fit(positions, values, dataset.hundredths(parameter), method[3:], method.starts_with("ll_"), diagnostics)
            kernel_models = [fit]
            fitted = fit.fitted
            leverage = fit.leverage
            has_edf = fit.defined
            has_leverage = fit.defined
            edf = fit.edf
        elif method.starts_with("loess")
            degree := int(method[5:])
            fit := loess.Fit(positions, values, dataset.hundredths(parameter), degree, if robust then settings.robust_iterations else 0, diagnostics)
            loess_models = [fit]
            fitted = fit.fitted
            leverage = fit.leverage
            edf = fit.edf
        else
            penalty := real64(parameter)
            fit := spline.Fit(positions, values, penalty, diagnostics)
            spline_models = [fit]
            fitted = fit.fitted
            leverage = fit.leverage
            edf = fit.edf

    Estimate evaluate(int position, need_weights := false)
        count := int(#positions)
        if method == "linear"
            value := intercept + slope * (as_real(position) / 100.0)
            real64[] weights := []
            if need_weights
                for point := positions[]
                    weights = weights.append(1.0 / as_real(count) + (as_real(position) / 100.0 - xbar) * (as_real(point) / 100.0 - xbar) / sxx)
            return Estimate(true, value, weights)
        if method == "running_mean" or method == "running_median"
            nearest := 0
            for: 1 <= index < count
                if absolute(positions[index] - position) < absolute(positions[nearest] - position)
                    nearest = index
            real64[] weights := []
            if need_weights
                window := windows[nearest]
                for: index < count
                    weights = weights.append(if index >= window[0] and index <= window[1] then 1.0 / as_real(window[1] - window[0] + 1) else 0.0)
            return Estimate(true, fitted[nearest], weights)
        if method == "isotonic"
            selected := 0
            for: index < count
                if positions[index] <= position
                    selected = index
            return Estimate(true, fitted[selected])
        if method.starts_with("nw_") or method.starts_with("ll_")
            result := kernel_models[0].evaluate(position)
            return Estimate(result.defined, result.value, result.weights)
        if method.starts_with("loess")
            result := loess_models[0].local_fit(position)
            return Estimate(true, result.value, result.weights)
        value := spline_models[0].estimate(position)
        real64[] weights := []
        if need_weights
            weights = spline_models[0].weights(position)
        return Estimate(true, value, weights)

Model fit_model(string method, string parameter, dataset.Point[] points, dataset.Settings settings, string direction, robust := true, diagnostics := true)
    positions := [for point := points[] then point.position]
    numbers := [for point := points[] then point.value]
    model := Model(method, positions, numbers)
    .model.initialize(parameter, settings, direction, robust, diagnostics)
    return model

class Score(bool defined, real64 value)

Score validation(string method, string parameter, dataset.Point[] points, dataset.Settings settings, string direction, int folds)
    real64[] predictions := array(#points, fill = 0.0)
    for: group < folds
        dataset.Point[] training := []
        for: index < int(#points)
            if index % folds != group
                training = training.append(points[index])
        model := fit_model(method, parameter, training, settings, direction, false, false)
        for: group <= index < int(#points) step folds
            prediction := model.evaluate(points[index].position)
            if not prediction.defined
                return Score(false, 0.0)
            predictions[index] = prediction.value
    observed := [for point := points[] then as_real(point.value) / 100.0]
    return Score(true, selection.cv(observed, predictions))

string[] methods_in_order(dataset.Settings settings)
    methods := ["linear", "running_mean", "running_median"]
    for prefix := ["nw_", "ll_"][]
        for kernel := settings.kernels[]
            methods = methods.append(prefix + kernel)
    for degree := settings.degrees[]
        methods = methods.append("loess" + degree)
    return methods.concat(["spline", "isotonic"])

string[] parameters(string method, dataset.Settings settings)
    return if method.starts_with("running_") then settings.windows elif method.starts_with("nw_") or method.starts_with("ll_") then settings.bandwidths elif method.starts_with("loess") then settings.spans elif method == "spline" then settings.lambdas else []

class Candidate(string parameter, Score score, bool has_edf, real64 edf, selected := false)
class Entry(string method, string parameter, Model model, real64 loo, Score kfold, Candidate[] candidates, real64 gcv)
    Estimate[] grid_values := []

Entry[] select_models(dataset.Point[] points, dataset.Settings settings, string[] methods, string mode)
    Entry[] entries := []
    observed := [for point := points[] then as_real(point.value) / 100.0]
    for method := methods[]
        Candidate[] candidates := []
        for parameter := parameters(method, settings)[]
            candidate := fit_model(method, parameter, points, settings, mode, false)
            score := Score(true, 0.0)
            if method == "spline"
                score.value = selection.gcv(observed, candidate.fitted, candidate.edf)
            else
                score = validation(method, parameter, points, settings, mode, int(#points))
            candidates = candidates.append(Candidate(parameter, score, candidate.has_edf, candidate.edf))
        best := -1
        parameter := if method == "linear" then "-" else mode
        if #candidates > 0
            best = selection.choose([for candidate := candidates[] then candidate.score.value], [for candidate := candidates[] then candidate.score.defined])
            candidates[best].selected = true
            parameter = candidates[best].parameter
        model := fit_model(method, parameter, points, settings, mode)
        direction := if method == "isotonic" then model.direction else mode
        if method == "isotonic"
            parameter = direction
        real64 loo := 0.0
        if best >= 0 and method != "spline"
            loo = candidates[best].score.value
        else
            score := validation(method, parameter, points, settings, direction, int(#points))
            loo = score.value
        kfold := validation(method, parameter, points, settings, direction, settings.folds)
        gcv := if method == "spline" then candidates[best].score.value else 0.0
        entries = entries.append(Entry(method, parameter, model, loo, kfold, candidates, gcv))
    return entries

class Statistics(real64[] residuals, real64 rss, bool has_edf, real64 edf, real64 df, real64 rse, real64 r2, bool has_nonlinear, real64 nonlinear, real64[] acf, real64 dw, int runs, int positive, int negative, real64 runs_z, int largest, real64[] quantiles, int turning)

real64[] residual_quantiles(real64[] residuals)
    ordered := residuals.sorted()
    real64[] result := []
    for: k <= 4
        index := (int(#ordered) - 1) * k / 4
        remainder := (int(#ordered) - 1) * k % 4
        value := ordered[index]
        if remainder != 0
            value += as_real(remainder) / 4.0 * (ordered[index + 1] - ordered[index])
        result = result.append(value)
    return result

Statistics fit_statistics(Entry entry, real64[] observed, real64 linear_rss)
    count := int(#observed)
    real64[] residuals := []
    mean := total(observed) / as_real(count)
    real64 tss := 0.0
    for: index < count
        residuals = residuals.append(observed[index] - entry.model.fitted[index])
        tss += (observed[index] - mean) * (observed[index] - mean)
    rss := squared_sum(residuals)
    edf := entry.model.edf
    df := if entry.model.has_edf then as_real(count) - edf else 0.0
    rse := if entry.model.has_edf then square_root(rss / df) else 0.0
    has_nonlinear := entry.method != "linear" and entry.model.has_edf and edf > 2.0
    nonlinear := if has_nonlinear then ((linear_rss - rss) / (edf - 2.0)) / (rss / df) else 0.0
    residual_mean := total(residuals) / as_real(count)
    centered := [for value := residuals[] then value - residual_mean]
    denominator := squared_sum(centered)
    real64[] acf := []
    for: 1 <= lag <= 5
        real64 sum := 0.0
        for: index < count - lag
            sum += centered[index] * centered[index + lag]
        acf = acf.append(sum / denominator)
    real64 dw := 0.0
    largest := 0
    runs := 0
    positive := 0
    negative := 0
    previous_sign := 0
    for: index < count
        value := residuals[index]
        if index > 0
            dw += (value - residuals[index - 1]) * (value - residuals[index - 1])
        if absolute_real(value) > absolute_real(residuals[largest])
            largest = index
        if value != 0.0
            sign := if value > 0.0 then 1 else -1
            if sign > 0
                positive += 1
            else
                negative += 1
            if previous_sign != sign
                runs += 1
            previous_sign = sign
    nonzero := positive + negative
    product := 2 * positive * negative
    runs_mean := 1.0 + as_real(product) / as_real(nonzero)
    variance := as_real(product * (product - nonzero)) / as_real(nonzero * nonzero * (nonzero - 1))
    turning := 0
    has_previous := false
    real64 previous_value := 0.0
    previous_difference := 0
    for estimate := entry.grid_values[]
        if estimate.defined
            if has_previous and estimate.value != previous_value
                sign := if estimate.value > previous_value then 1 else -1
                if previous_difference != 0 and sign != previous_difference
                    turning += 1
                previous_difference = sign
            has_previous = true
            previous_value = estimate.value
    return Statistics(residuals, rss, entry.model.has_edf, edf, df, rse, 1.0 - rss / tss, has_nonlinear, nonlinear, acf, dw / rss, runs, positive, negative, (as_real(runs) - runs_mean) / square_root(variance), largest, residual_quantiles(residuals), turning)

            return index
    return -1

Analysis analyze(dataset.Point[] points, dataset.Settings settings, string[] methods, string mode, Generator &generator)
    count := int(#points)
    positions := [for point := points[] then point.position]
    observed := [for point := points[] then as_real(point.value) / 100.0]
    int[] grid := []
    for: int k < settings.grid_points
        grid = grid.append(positions[0] + k * (positions[count - 1] - positions[0]) / (settings.grid_points - 1))
    entries := select_models(points, settings, methods, mode)
    linear_rss := residual_square(observed, entries[0].model.fitted)
    Statistics[] statistics := []
    int[] ranking := []
    for: index < int(#entries)
        entry := entries[index]
        entry.grid_values = [for position := grid[] then entry.model.evaluate(position)]
        entries[index] = entry
        statistics = statistics.append(fit_statistics(entry, observed, linear_rss))
        place := int(#ranking)
        ranking = ranking.append(index)
        while place > 0 and entries[index].loo < entries[ranking[place - 1]].loo
            ranking[place] = ranking[place - 1]
            place -= 1
        ranking[place] = index
    Agreement[] agreements := []
    for: index < int(#entries)
        used := 0
        real64 sum := 0.0
        real64 maximum := -1.0
        at := 0
        for: k < int(#grid)
            own := entries[index].grid_values[k]
            best := entries[ranking[0]].grid_values[k]
            if own.defined and best.defined
                delta := absolute_real(own.value - best.value)
                used += 1
                sum += delta * delta
                if delta > maximum
                    maximum = delta
                    at = k
        agreements = agreements.append(Agreement(used, square_root(sum / as_real(used)), maximum, grid[at]))
    spline_index := method_index(methods, "spline")
    real64 maximum_slope := 0.0
    real64 minimum_slope := 0.0
    at_maximum := 1
    at_minimum := 1
    for: 1 <= index < int(#grid) - 1
        value := (entries[spline_index].grid_values[index + 1].value - entries[spline_index].grid_values[index - 1].value) / (as_real(grid[index + 1] - grid[index - 1]) / 100.0)
        if index == 1 or value > maximum_slope
            maximum_slope = value
            at_maximum = index
        if index == 1 or value < minimum_slope
            minimum_slope = value
            at_minimum = index
    slope := [maximum_slope, as_real(grid[at_maximum]), minimum_slope, as_real(grid[at_minimum])]
    outlier_method := -1
    for index := ranking[]
        if entries[index].model.has_leverage
            outlier_method = index
            break
    outlier_entry := entries[outlier_method]
    outlier_stats := statistics[outlier_method]
    real64[] standardized := array(nat(count), fill = 0.0)
    real64[] cooks := array(nat(count), fill = 0.0)
    defined := array(nat(count), fill = false)
    int[] outliers := []
    int[] influential := []
    for: index < count
        leverage := outlier_entry.model.leverage[index]
        if leverage < 1.0
            value := outlier_stats.residuals[index] / (outlier_stats.rse * square_root(1.0 - leverage))
            standardized[index] = value
            defined[index] = true
            cooks[index] = value * value * leverage / ((1.0 - leverage) * outlier_entry.model.edf)
            influential = influential.append(index)
            if absolute_real(value) > settings.threshold
                outliers = outliers.append(index)
    for: pass < int(#outliers)
        for: index < int(#outliers) - 1 - pass
            if absolute_real(standardized[outliers[index + 1]]) > absolute_real(standardized[outliers[index]])
                saved := outliers[index]
                outliers[index] = outliers[index + 1]
                outliers[index + 1] = saved
    for: pass < int(#influential)
        for: index < int(#influential) - 1 - pass
            if cooks[influential[index + 1]] > cooks[influential[index]]
                saved := influential[index]
                influential[index] = influential[index + 1]
                influential[index + 1] = saved
    if #influential > 3
        influential = influential[0:<3]
    outlier := Outliers(outlier_method, standardized, defined, cooks, outliers, influential)
    Band[][] bands := []
    BandSummary[] summaries := []
    for method := settings.band_methods[]
        selected := method_index(methods, method)
        entry := entries[selected]
        stats := statistics[selected]
        Band[] rows := []
        real64 se_sum := 0.0
        used := 0
        covered := 0
        for position := grid[]
            estimate := entry.model.evaluate(position, true)
            if estimate.defined
                se := stats.rse * square_root(squared_sum(estimate.weights))
                rows = rows.append(Band(true, estimate.value, se, estimate.value - settings.band_z * se, estimate.value + settings.band_z * se))
                se_sum += se
                used += 1
            else
                rows = rows.append(Band())
        for: index < count
            estimate := entry.model.evaluate(positions[index], true)
            se := stats.rse * square_root(squared_sum(estimate.weights))
            if absolute_real(stats.residuals[index]) <= settings.band_z * square_root(stats.rse * stats.rse + se * se)
                covered += 1
        bands = bands.append(rows)
        summaries = summaries.append(BandSummary(se_sum / as_real(used), covered))
    spline_model := entries[spline_index].model.spline_models[0]
    residuals := statistics[spline_index].residuals
    residual_mean := total(residuals) / as_real(count)
    centered := [for value := residuals[] then value - residual_mean]
    real64[][] estimates := array(#grid, fill = [])
    for: int repetition < settings.bootstrap
        real64[] response := []
        for: index < count
            draw := .generator.draw()
            response = response.append(spline_model.fitted[index] + centered[draw % count])
        fit := spline_model.fit_values(response)
        for: index < int(#grid)
            estimates[index] = estimates[index].append(spline_model.evaluate_fit(fit.fitted, fit.gamma, grid[index]))
    Band[] bootstrap_bands := []
    for: index < int(#grid)
        mean := total(estimates[index]) / as_real(settings.bootstrap)
        real64 sum := 0.0
        for value := estimates[index][]
            sum += (value - mean) * (value - mean)
        ordered := estimates[index].sorted()
        bootstrap_bands = bootstrap_bands.append(Band(true, entries[spline_index].grid_values[index].value, square_root(sum / as_real(settings.bootstrap - 1)), ordered[settings.trim], ordered[settings.bootstrap - settings.trim - 1]))
    bands = bands.append(bootstrap_bands)
    return Analysis(points, grid, entries, statistics, ranking, agreements, slope, outlier, bands, summaries)

string real_text(real64 value, places := 4)
    text := if places == 2 then "{value:.2}" else "{value:.4}"
    return if text == "-0.0000" then "0.0000" elif text == "-0.00" then "0.00" else text

string maybe_real(real64 value, bool defined)
    return if defined then real_text(value) else "NA"

string position_text(int value)
    magnitude := absolute(value)
    return (if value < 0 then "-" else "") + "{magnitude / 100}.{magnitude % 100:02.}"

string reals(real64[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then real_text(value)].join(" ")

int[] bounds(dataset.Point[] points)
    low := points[0].value
    high := low
    for point := points[]
        if point.value < low
            low = point.value
        if point.value > high
            high = point.value
    return [low, high]

string[] diagnostic_block(string name, Analysis analysis, string[] methods, dataset.Settings settings)
    points := analysis.points
    limits := bounds(points)
    lines := ["series {name} n {#points} x " + position_text(points[0].position) + " " + position_text(points[-1].position) + " y " + position_text(limits[0]) + " " + position_text(limits[1])]
    for: index < int(#methods)
        entry := analysis.entries[index]
        stats := analysis.statistics[index]
        first := "method {entry.method} parameter {entry.parameter} loo " + real_text(entry.loo)
        if entry.method == "spline"
            first += " gcv " + real_text(entry.gcv)
        lines = lines.concat([first,
            "  rss " + real_text(stats.rss) + " edf " + maybe_real(stats.edf, stats.has_edf) + " df " + maybe_real(stats.df, stats.has_edf) + " rse " + maybe_real(stats.rse, stats.has_edf) + " r2 " + real_text(stats.r2) + " f_nonlinear " + maybe_real(stats.nonlinear, stats.has_nonlinear),
            "  acf " + reals(stats.acf) + " dw " + real_text(stats.dw),
            "  runs {stats.runs} positive {stats.positive} negative {stats.negative} z " + real_text(stats.runs_z),
            "  max_residual " + real_text(stats.residuals[stats.largest]) + " at " + position_text(points[stats.largest].position) + " turning {stats.turning}",
            "  quantiles " + reals(stats.quantiles)])
        if entry.method.starts_with("loess")
            model := entry.model.loess_models[0]
            for record := model.records[]
                lines = lines.append("  robust {record.iteration} scale " + real_text(record.scale) + " zero_weight {record.zeros} max_change " + real_text(record.change))
            string[] zeros := []
            for: point < int(#points)
                if model.rho[point] == 0.0
                    zeros = zeros.append(position_text(points[point].position))
            lines = lines.append("  zero_weight_points " + (if #zeros > 0 then zeros.join(" ") else "none"))
    lines = lines.append("ranking")
    for: rank < int(#methods)
        entry := analysis.entries[analysis.ranking[rank]]
        lines = lines.append("  {rank + 1} {entry.method} " + real_text(entry.loo) + " kfold " + maybe_real(entry.kfold.value, entry.kfold.defined))
    lines = lines.append("agreement with " + methods[analysis.ranking[0]])
    for: index < int(#methods)
        if index != analysis.ranking[0]
            agreement := analysis.agreements[index]
            lines = lines.append("  {methods[index]} points {agreement.count} rms " + real_text(agreement.rms) + " max " + real_text(agreement.maximum) + " at " + position_text(agreement.position))
    lines = lines.append("slope spline max " + real_text(analysis.slope[0]) + " at " + position_text(floor_value(analysis.slope[1])) + " min " + real_text(analysis.slope[2]) + " at " + position_text(floor_value(analysis.slope[3])))
    outlier := analysis.outlier
    outlier_entry := analysis.entries[outlier.method]
    outlier_stats := analysis.statistics[outlier.method]
    lines = lines.append("outliers method {outlier_entry.method} threshold " + real_text(settings.threshold, 2))
    for index := outlier.outliers[]
        lines = lines.append("  x " + position_text(points[index].position) + " y " + position_text(points[index].value) + " fit " + real_text(outlier_entry.model.fitted[index]) + " residual " + real_text(outlier_stats.residuals[index]) + " standardized " + real_text(outlier.standardized[index]))
    if #outlier.outliers == 0
        lines = lines.append("  none")
    lines = lines.append("influence method " + outlier_entry.method)
    for index := outlier.influential[]
        lines = lines.append("  x " + position_text(points[index].position) + " lev " + real_text(outlier_entry.model.leverage[index]) + " cook " + real_text(outlier.cooks[index]))
    lines = lines.append("bands")
    for: index < int(#settings.band_methods)
        summary := analysis.summaries[index]
        lines = lines.append("  {settings.band_methods[index]} mean_se " + real_text(summary.mean_se) + " coverage {summary.covered} of {#points}")
    return lines

string[] isotonic_block(string name, Analysis analysis, string[] methods)
    selected := method_index(methods, "isotonic")
    entry := analysis.entries[selected]
    model := entry.model
    first := "series {name} direction {model.direction} mode {model.mode}"
    if model.mode == "auto"
        first += " rss_increasing " + real_text(model.rss_increasing) + " rss_decreasing " + real_text(model.rss_decreasing)
    lines := [first, "blocks {#model.blocks} rss " + real_text(analysis.statistics[selected].rss) + " loo " + real_text(entry.loo)]
    for: index < int(#model.blocks)
        block := model.blocks[index]
        lines = lines.append("block {index + 1} x " + position_text(model.positions[block.first]) + " " + position_text(model.positions[block.last]) + " count {block.count} value " + real_text(as_real(block.sum) / as_real(100 * block.count)))
    return lines

string[] framed(string[][] grid)
    border := "+" + array(#grid[0], fill = "-").join("") + "+"
    lines := [border]
    for row := grid[]
        lines = lines.append("|" + row.join("") + "|")
    return lines.append(border)

string[] plot_block(string name, Analysis analysis, string[] methods, dataset.Settings settings)
    points := analysis.points
    width := settings.width
    height := settings.height
    xa := points[0].position
    xb := points[-1].position
    limits := bounds(points)
    ya := limits[0]
    yb := limits[1]
    int[] columns := []
    grid := array(nat(height), fill = array(nat(width), fill = " "))
    for point := points[]
        column := width * (point.position - xa) / (xb - xa)
        row := height * (yb - point.value) / (yb - ya)
        if column == width
            column -= 1
        if row == height
            row -= 1
        columns = columns.append(column)
        grid[row][column] = "."
    legend := ["legend . data"]
    for: index < int(#settings.plot_methods)
        method := settings.plot_methods[index]
        legend = legend.append("{index + 1} {method}")
        entry := analysis.entries[method_index(methods, method)]
        digit := "{index + 1}"
        for: int column < width
            position := xa + (2 * column + 1) * (xb - xa) / (2 * width)
            estimate := entry.model.evaluate(position)
            if not estimate.defined
                continue
            pi := as_real(height) * (as_real(yb) / 100.0 - estimate.value) / (as_real(yb) / 100.0 - as_real(ya) / 100.0)
            row := floor_value(pi)
            if row < 0
                row = 0
            if row >= height
                row = height - 1
            old := grid[row][column]
            grid[row][column] = if old == " " or old == "." or old == digit then digit else "*"
    lines := ["plot {name} size {width}x{height} x " + position_text(xa) + " " + position_text(xb) + " y " + position_text(ya) + " " + position_text(yb), legend.join(" ")].concat(framed(grid))
    data_cells := 0
    curve_cells := 0
    overlaps := 0
    for row := grid[]
        for value := row[]
            if value == "."
                data_cells += 1
            elif value == "*"
                overlaps += 1
            elif value != " "
                curve_cells += 1
    lines = lines.append("cells data {data_cells} curve {curve_cells} overlap {overlaps}")
    best := analysis.ranking[0]
    residuals := analysis.statistics[best].residuals
    real64 limit := 0.0
    for value := residuals[]
        if absolute_real(value) > limit
            limit = absolute_real(value)
    grid = array(nat(height), fill = array(nat(width), fill = " "))
    grid[height / 2] = array(nat(width), fill = "-")
    for: index < int(#points)
        row := floor_value(as_real(height) * ((limit - residuals[index]) / (2.0 * limit)))
        if row < 0
            row = 0
        if row >= height
            row = height - 1
        grid[row][columns[index]] = "o"
    lines = lines.concat(["", "residuals {name} method {methods[best]} limit " + real_text(limit)]).concat(framed(grid))
    lines = lines.concat(["", "histogram {name} method {methods[analysis.outlier.method]}"])
    counts := array(14, fill = 0)
    for: index < int(#points)
        if analysis.outlier.defined[index]
            value := analysis.outlier.standardized[index]
            bucket := if value < -3.0 then 0 elif value >= 3.0 then 13 else 1 + floor_value((value + 3.0) / 0.5)
            counts[bucket] += 1
    for: index < 14
        lower := if index == 0 then "-inf" else real_text(-3.0 + 0.5 * as_real(index - 1), 2)
        upper := if index == 13 then "inf" else real_text(-3.0 + 0.5 * as_real(index), 2)
        lines = lines.append(lower + " " + upper + " {counts[index]} |" + array(nat(counts[index]), fill = "#").join(""))
    return lines

string[] join_blocks(string[][] blocks)
    string[] lines := []
    for: index < int(#blocks)
        if index > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        lines = lines.concat(blocks[index])
    return lines

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

real64 as_real(int value)
    converted := real64(value)
    return converted

real64 total(real64[] values)
    real64 result := 0.0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

real64 cv(real64[] observed, real64[] predicted)
    real64 sum := 0.0
    for: index < int(#observed)
        residual := observed[index] - predicted[index]
        sum += residual * residual
    return sum / as_real(int(#observed))

real64 gcv(real64[] observed, real64[] fitted, real64 edf)
    factor := 1.0 - edf / as_real(int(#observed))
    return cv(observed, fitted) / (factor * factor)

int choose(real64[] scores, bool[] defined)
    best := -1
    for: index < int(#scores)
        if defined[index] and (best < 0 or scores[index] < scores[best])
            best = index
    return best

import selection = "./selection.qui"

class Values(real64[] fitted, real64[] gamma)

class Fit(int[] positions, real64[] values, real64 penalty, bool diagnostics)
    x := [for position := positions[] then selection.as_real(position) / 100.0]
    real64[] h := []
    real64[] d := []
    real64[] l1 := []
    real64[] l2 := []
    real64[] fitted := []
    real64[] gamma := []
    Values[] basis := []
    real64[] leverage := []
    real64 edf := 0.0
    for: index < int(#x) - 1
        h = h.append(x[index + 1] - x[index])
    local size := int(#x) - 2
    local real64[] a := []
    local real64[] b := []
    local real64[] c := []
    for: index < size
        a = a.append(1.0 / h[index])
        c = c.append(1.0 / h[index + 1])
        b = b.append(-(a[index] + c[index]))
    local real64[] diagonal := []
    local real64[] first := []
    local real64[] second := []
    for: index < size
        diagonal = diagonal.append((h[index] + h[index + 1]) / 3.0 + penalty * (a[index] * a[index] + b[index] * b[index] + c[index] * c[index]))
        if index + 1 < size
            first = first.append(h[index + 1] / 6.0 + penalty * c[index] * (b[index] + b[index + 1]))
        if index + 2 < size
            second = second.append(penalty * c[index] * c[index + 1])
    d = array(nat(size), fill = 0.0)
    l1 = array(nat(size), fill = 0.0)
    l2 = array(nat(size), fill = 0.0)
    for: index < size
        if index >= 2
            l2[index] = second[index - 2] / d[index - 2]
        if index >= 1
            local correction := if index >= 2 then l2[index] * d[index - 2] * l1[index - 1] else 0.0
            l1[index] = (first[index - 1] - correction) / d[index - 1]
        local value := diagonal[index]
        if index >= 1
            value -= l1[index] * l1[index] * d[index - 1]
        if index >= 2
            value -= l2[index] * l2[index] * d[index - 2]
        d[index] = value
    local fit := fit_values(values)
    fitted = fit.fitted
    gamma = fit.gamma
    if diagnostics
        for: index < int(#x)
            local real64[] unit := array(#x, fill = 0.0)
            unit[index] = 1.0
            local response := fit_values(unit)
            basis = basis.append(response)
            leverage = leverage.append(response.fitted[index])
        edf = selection.total(leverage)

    Values fit_values(real64[] responses)
        count := int(#responses)
        size := count - 2
        real64[] z := array(nat(size), fill = 0.0)
        for: index < size
            value := (responses[index + 2] - responses[index + 1]) / h[index + 1] - (responses[index + 1] - responses[index]) / h[index]
            if index >= 1
                value -= l1[index] * z[index - 1]
            if index >= 2
                value -= l2[index] * z[index - 2]
            z[index] = value
        real64[] curvatures := array(nat(count), fill = 0.0)
        for: offset < size
            index := size - 1 - offset
            value := z[index] / d[index]
            if index + 1 < size
                value -= l1[index + 1] * curvatures[index + 2]
            if index + 2 < size
                value -= l2[index + 2] * curvatures[index + 3]
            curvatures[index + 1] = value
        adjustments := [(curvatures[1] - curvatures[0]) / h[0]]
        for: 1 <= index < count - 1
            adjustments = adjustments.append((curvatures[index + 1] - curvatures[index]) / h[index] - (curvatures[index] - curvatures[index - 1]) / h[index - 1])
        adjustments = adjustments.append(0.0 - (curvatures[count - 1] - curvatures[count - 2]) / h[count - 2])
        real64[] estimates := []
        for: index < count
            estimates = estimates.append(responses[index] - penalty * adjustments[index])
        return Values(estimates, curvatures)

    real64 evaluate_fit(real64[] estimates, real64[] curvatures, int position)
        x0 := selection.as_real(position) / 100.0
        count := int(#positions)
        index := 0
        while index < count and positions[index] < position
            index += 1
        if index < count and positions[index] == position
            return estimates[index]
        if index == 0
            slope := (estimates[1] - estimates[0]) / h[0] - h[0] * curvatures[1] / 6.0
            return estimates[0] - (x[0] - x0) * slope
        if index == count
            slope := (estimates[count - 1] - estimates[count - 2]) / h[count - 2] + h[count - 2] * curvatures[count - 2] / 6.0
            return estimates[count - 1] + (x0 - x[count - 1]) * slope
        left_index := index - 1
        left := x0 - x[left_index]
        right := x[index] - x0
        return (left * estimates[index] + right * estimates[left_index]) / h[left_index] - left * right * ((1.0 + left / h[left_index]) * curvatures[index] + (1.0 + right / h[left_index]) * curvatures[left_index]) / 6.0

    real64 estimate(int position)
        return evaluate_fit(fitted, gamma, position)

    real64[] weights(int position)
        real64[] result := []
        for response := basis[]
            result = result.append(evaluate_fit(response.fitted, response.gamma, position))
        return result
